Multi-Agent Patterns, Side by Side

The same task, “compare our refund policy with three competitors and draft an update”, run through seven ways of arranging agents. Pick a pattern and press run: messages move between agents, and the counters show model calls, waiting time and tokens. Then make one agent get it wrong and see which patterns catch it.
